head.title: King St Tattoo · Jacksonville, FL
head.description: King St Tattoo, Jacksonville FL: traditional, Japanese, color and black and grey custom tattoos. 4.8 stars, 170 Google reviews. Call (904) 518-5912.
head.og_description: 4.8 stars on Google, 170 reviews. A wall of flash and a team of artists who feel like family.

jsonld.name: King St Tattoo
jsonld.description: Custom tattoo studio in Jacksonville, FL: traditional, Japanese, color and black and grey work.

script.es: Arte que se queda, hecho por artistas que se nota que lo aman.
script.en: Art that stays, made by artists who clearly love the craft.

parrafo.es: Un estudio de tatuajes en Jacksonville con un equipo que se siente como familia. Estilo tradicional, japones, a color y black and grey, respaldado por 170 reseñas en Google.
parrafo.en: A Jacksonville tattoo studio with a team that feels like family. Traditional, Japanese, color and black and grey work, backed by 170 Google reviews.

hero.imagen_alt: Color tattoo of a koi fish with lotus flowers and waves on a thigh, by King St Tattoo

parrafo_1.es: King St Tattoo es un estudio en Jacksonville con una pared completa de flash y un equipo de artistas residentes. Trabajan estilo tradicional, japones, color y black and grey.
parrafo_1.en: King St Tattoo is a Jacksonville studio with a full wall of flash art and a team of resident artists. They work in traditional, Japanese, color and black and grey styles.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dicen lo mismo: se siente como familia. Dustin Spegal llego con Ryan por una pieza en el antebrazo y termino encargando una manga de 3/4 completa por lo detallado del resultado.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review says the same thing: it feels like family. Dustin Spegal first saw Ryan for a forearm piece and ended up commissioning a full 3/4 sleeve because the detail was so good.

texto.es: Cuentanos tu idea o elige una pieza de la pared de flash.
texto.en: Tell us your idea or pick a piece off the flash wall.

titulo.en: You get matched with an artist

texto.es: Te conectamos con el artista indicado del equipo segun tu idea.
texto.en: We connect you with the right artist on the team for your idea.

texto.es: Tu pieza tatuada con cuidado, en un ambiente que se siente como familia.
texto.en: Your piece, tattooed with care, in a shop that feels like family.

texto.es: Detalle de calidad que a veces termina en una pieza mas grande.
texto.en: Quality detail that sometimes turns into an even bigger piece.

nota.es: Precios segun tamano y detalle de la pieza. Llama para cotizar la tuya.
nota.en: Prices vary by size and detail. Call for a quote on yours.

texto.es: Bulldogs, calaveras y piezas clasicas de linea gruesa a color.
texto.en: Bulldogs, skulls and classic bold-line color pieces.

texto.es: Koi, dragones y flores de loto con olas, a todo color.
texto.en: Koi, dragons and lotus flowers with waves, in full color.

texto.es: Disenos neo-tradicionales y de temporada con color vibrante.
texto.en: Neo-traditional and seasonal designs in vibrant color.

texto.es: Calaveras, simbolos y piezas de manos y antebrazos.
texto.en: Skulls, symbols and hand and forearm pieces.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu idea? Llama igual, el equipo seguro la cubre.
pie.en: Do not see your idea listed? Call anyway, the team likely covers it.

items.quote: I had an amazing experience getting my tattoo done by Andy. He did a phenomenal job on the linework and made the whole process feel easy and comfortable. Andy is super friendly, personable, and genuinely funny, the kind of artist who makes...

Love this shop. Love Ryan and Andy. Ryan is incredibly talented and really listens. First saw him on a whim to get a piece on my forearm and the work was so incredibly detailed I commissioned him to do a 3/4 sleeve on my other arm...

I adore this shop and the artists there feel like family. The art is stellar, not a single slack artist in the building. I miss Chris being there, may he rest in peace. King Street Tattoo is my absolute go to...
